newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 23.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:

* MGM Inc is seeking off-balance-sheet financing and is negotiating an insurance guarantee deal to stretch its production financing, according to sources. MGM has approached London insurance brokers C.E. Heath & Co about guaranteeing production financing for at least one and perhaps four of its films.
The arrangement, if concluded, would be a form of credit enhancement enabling the studio to gain additional bank financing for film production.
* Tele-Communications Inc on Wednesday said it will recommend the reinstatement of both MTV and VH1 in all of the markets where TCI systems had dropped them at the end of '96.
* Fine Line Features has taken North American rights to writer-director-actress Troy Beyer's feature film weaving video interviews with 300 women from Miami's South Beach.
* Former studio executive Lance Young has completed his directorial debut on a romantic drama called Bliss.

* USA Network, jointly owned by Seagram Co Ltd and Viacom Inc, has bought six pictures for exclusive three-year license terms following their run on pay TV. Industry sources say USA will pay about $4 million a title.
* Warner Bros soundtrack for the movie Evita was the No. 2 album in the nation last week, according to label execs. Warner Bros is owned by Time Warner Inc.
